verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench (Document Driver) explicitly generates Delaware corporation/LLC formation documents, and its VC/emerging-companies practice advises 1,200+ startups, supporting the core formation-incorporation story. However, the evidence never explicitly enumerates charter, bylaws, initial board consents, and founder stock purchase agreements as deliverables — only generic 'formation documents' are named. Missing for 10: explicit listing of bylaws/board consent/founder stock purchase document types, and independent confirmation that the firm itself (not just the free tool) handles full incorporation engagements for founders.
